definitions.gloss: manufacturing cost; cost of production; cost of goods manufactured
definitions.explanation: The total cost incurred in producing goods, including raw materials, labor, and factory overhead. A key accounting term used in financial statements and business management.

examples.japanese: {製造原価|せいぞうげんか}を{下|さ}げる{方法|ほうほう}を{考|かんが}えている。
examples.english: We are thinking of ways to reduce manufacturing costs.

examples.japanese: {原材料|げんざいりょう}の{高騰|こうとう}で{製造原価|せいぞうげんか}が{上|あ}がった。
examples.english: Manufacturing costs rose due to the surge in raw material prices.

examples.japanese: {製造原価|せいぞうげんか}には{材料費|ざいりょうひ}、{労務費|ろうむひ}、{経費|けいひ}の{三|みっ}つの{要素|ようそ}が{含|ふく}まれる。
examples.english: Manufacturing cost includes three elements: material costs, labor costs, and overhead expenses.

notes:
Composed of {製造|せいぞう} (manufacturing) and {原価|げんか} (cost price, prime cost). This is a fundamental accounting and business term used in {製造原価報告書|せいぞうげんかほうこくしょ} (manufacturing cost statements), which are part of standard Japanese financial reporting for manufacturing companies.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {製造原価|せいぞうげんか}を{計算|けいさん}する: to calculate manufacturing cost
- {製造原価|せいぞうげんか}を{削減|さくげん}する: to cut manufacturing costs
- {製造原価|せいぞうげんか}{報告書|ほうこくしょ}: manufacturing cost statement
- {製品|せいひん}{一個|いっこ}{当|あ}たりの{製造原価|せいぞうげんか}: manufacturing cost per unit

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {原価|げんか}: cost price — broader term covering manufacturing, purchasing, or service delivery costs
- {売上原価|うりあげげんか}: cost of goods sold — the cost recognized when goods are actually sold
- {仕入原価|しいれげんか}: purchase cost — cost of goods bought from suppliers for resale
